Metadata.title: The 'Brook
Metadata.summary: The last ferry of the season leaves without its captain, and the crossing takes far longer than it should. A night-shift radio host keeps taking calls from a listener who knows what the next song will be. Nothing in the town is quite what the visitors were promised. A retired clockmaker is asked to repair a machine that should not be able to keep time at all. After the harvest fails, a village sends its youngest cartographer to find where the river went.

CommonSenseMedia.oneLiner: Slow-burning mystery has peril and mild language.

Metadata.title: Now You Hear It: Now You Don't
Metadata.summary: Three siblings inherit a hotel with one more room than its floor plan allows. A stage magician's assistant realises the trick only works because someone in the audience is helping. A surveyor returns to the valley she left as a child and finds the maps no longer match the land. An apprentice archivist finds a ledger that records events a week before they happen.

Metadata.title: Anchors & Daggers
Metadata.summary: After the harvest fails, a village sends its youngest cartographer to find where the river went. Old loyalties are tested, and not everyone who set out will see the far shore. When the night train stops between stations, its passengers discover that nobody remembers boarding.
Metadata.tagline: It was always the quiet one.

Metadata.title: Argo 31
Metadata.summary: An apprentice archivist finds a ledger that records events a week before they happen. The crew of a salvage tug answers a distress call from a ship that sank forty years earlier. The answer, when it comes, is stranger and kinder than anyone expected. The last ferry of the season leaves without its captain, and the crossing takes far longer than it should. A night-shift radio host keeps taking calls from a listener who knows what the next song will be.
